main.description: A voice recording captured by Pebble Index: the audio as a blob plus its transcript. Blob access control is at the record layer, so the audio is only reachable by parties with access to the space.

audio.description: The recorded audio, AAC in an MP4 container.

trigger.description: The device gesture that started the recording, when known.

client.description: The capture device or app that produced the recording (e.g. "ring").

recordingId.description: The capturing app's identifier for the recording, when known.

createdAt.description: When this record was created, if different from recordedAt.
